Ohio.what_qualifies: dismissals and acquittals; misdemeanors; 4th/5th-degree and some 3rd-degree felonies

Oklahoma.waiting_period: immediate for dismissals; 5 years for one nonviolent felony; 10 years for two
Oklahoma.what_qualifies: dismissals and acquittals; deferred sentences; nonviolent misdemeanors and felonies

Oregon.what_qualifies: most misdemeanors and eligible felonies (no Class A, violent, or sex offenses)
